name: House of Cards
text: Gain +30 contract value. When your team misses its contract, you lose this sigil.

signature.trigger: always; your team misses its contract
signature.effect: contract value +30; lost on a miss

decision: How safely to bid: every miss risks the sigil, so it rewards steady contracts and punishes a gamble.
opponent: Visible; setting your team also knocks the sigil down.
aiNote: Bid a half trick more conservatively.
rationale: Three times Sturdy Wall's +10, paid only on a made contract, and lost on the first miss: at an 80% make rate it lasts about five rounds and pays about +120 over its life, a fragile common that suits a careful deck. A copy of it is never lost.
deviation: Revision 1: replaced a capped, resetting streak counter, which read like Growing City (GY-C20).
